name: neubrutalism-orca-theme
description: A Neubrutalism-style theme for Orca Notes — hard shadows, thick borders, zero border-radius.

scripts.build:deploy: npm run build:css && npm run build:plugin-css && node scripts/deploy.cjs
scripts.build: npm run build:css && cross-env NODE_ENV=production tsc && vite build
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run build:plugin-css && node scripts/deploy.cjs
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run lint:css
